invariants.message: Retrieval/storage embedding dimension must be 384 (vector(384)) per the bge-small-en-v1.5 lock (ADR-0015). 1536 is only legitimate as the CSL full-mode gating vector or as a rejected alternative — not as the pgvector storage dimension.

invariants.authority: ADR-0003 amended (R2) · SOURCE_OF_TRUTH ("not Vectorize, not Qdrant")
invariants.message: Qdrant is DROPPED (ADR-0003 amended / R2). It must not appear as a live tier, store, or write target. Authority = Neon pgvector; derived edge cache = Vectorize. Qdrant may only be named in historical/rejected/competitor context.
Vectorize must never be declared a retrieval authority — it is a derived, reconstructible edge cache (dim-locked 384). pgvector is the sole retrieval authority (ADR-0003).

The locked embedding model is @cf/baai/bge-small-en-v1.5 (384, mean). Other embedding models/providers are only legitimate as named rejected alternatives or competitor references — not as live embedders.
